question: T12 (task-125d810e78c55b8d): on the desktop, does a block on a Scrolling block's rows that ends above its foot follow the foot as Wave Intensity grows past rows the Scrolling block was given by hand? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10); 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand. Ga: the Scrolling block placed at 1/2/5/26, the Text block as added (1/2/3/10); Gb and Gc: the same and the Text block placed at 2/2/4/10. Then the Scrolling block selected, Edit, Design ('open'); Ga and Gb a press on 180 (the range's end); Gc a mouse drag 0>30>...>180 through one DevTools session, a move every 300 ms, a quick read 80 ms after each, let go right after the last. Then Escape and a press on the page (go) and Cmd+Z until as built. Written as predictions first (predictions.txt in the lane folder). R1 ran Ga Gb Gc in one session, R2 Gc Gb Ga in another. Exit without saving each time.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: On the desktop a block on the Scrolling block's rows that ends above its foot neither follows nor is stretched as the foot grows past rows given by hand. Ga: the Scrolling block made 1/2/5/26, the Text block as added 1/2/3/10 (on its top row, other columns); a press on 180 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/7/26 (the line needs 6 rows) and the section from 8 to 10 rows, and the Text block stays 1/2/3/10. Gb: the Text block at 2/2/4/10 stays as 180 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/7/26. Gc: Gb by a drag from 0 out to 180, read 80 ms after each move: the hand-made rows hold through 120 (1/2/5/26, 8 rows), 150 takes 1/2/6/26 (9) and 180 1/2/7/26 (10); the Text block stays 2/2/4/10 throughout.

Escape keeps every area. Cmd+Z after it gives the Scrolling block 1/2/2/26 (Ga 6 rows, Gb and Gc 7), not the 1/2/5/26 it was made (as CAP-T12SHORT C and task-b4fedc8255866002), the Text block where it was; the next Cmd+Z takes back the place. R1 and R2 read alike in every read, held reads too.
Not read: the phone view, a fall, a block that starts below the Scrolling block's top and ends exactly on its foot.
